# rask Helm chart

![Version: 0.3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Version-0.3.0-informational?style=flat-square) ![Type: application](https://img.shields.io/badge/Type-application-informational?style=flat-square) ![AppVersion: 0.3.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/AppVersion-0.3.0-informational?style=flat-square)

<!-- GENERATED by helm-docs from values.yaml and this template. Edit those, then run `make chart-docs`;
     `make chart-docs-check` (part of `make check`) fails while this file is stale. -->

The single deploy artifact for rask on Kubernetes, for local k3s and production alike: one release named `rask`.
The topology and its prerequisites are in [docs/architecture/deployment.md](../docs/architecture/deployment.md);
the External Secrets Operator and a secret store are prerequisites rask never installs.

## Where things live

| What | Where |
|---|---|
| Every setting, with a one-line description | `values.yaml` (`# --` comments), tabulated below |
| The rationale for a template | `docs/chart/templates/<template>.md`, one section per template line it explains |
| Environment overlays | `deploy/values-local.yaml` (local k3s), `deploy/values-prod.yaml` (production shape), `deploy/values-live-pins.yaml` (`make k3s-pins`) |
| The local deploy | `make k3s-up`: the live release's image settings, then the pins, then `deploy/values-local.yaml` |

The overlays live outside `chart/` because Helm stores the chart's files in every release revision, and that
revision is one Kubernetes Secret capped at 1 MiB. Template rationale is kept out of `templates/` for the same reason.

| maintenance.compactThreads | int | `2` | Compaction read threads. Memory ceiling is scanBatchSize x row size x compactThreads; set the two together. |
| maintenance.controlEmit | bool | `false` | Announce each reclamation on the catalog control topic (catalog.control.v1); needs Dapr sidecars. Off by default. |
| maintenance.controlRoot | string | `""` | S3 root of the catalog's control registries (projects, warehouses, trash, `_bases/`). Empty uses the primary bucket; set together with the catalog's. |
| maintenance.daprAppId | string | `"maintenance"` | Dapr app-id of the maintenance planner and workers; also prefixes their durable consumer names. |
| maintenance.declaredPlatformRoots | string | `"s3://lance-catalog/medallion/models"` | Platform-owned store roots the catalog cannot resolve (e.g. medallion models) that the reconciler accounts for instead of reporting as unreadable. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.enabled | bool | `true` | Run compaction and index units on a separate worker Deployment and stop the planner consuming its own work queue. Needs `workTopic`. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.indexConcurrentUnits | int | `4` | Slice of `maxConcurrentUnits` reserved for index builds per worker; compaction gets the remainder. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.maxConcurrentCompactions | int | `4` | Memory bound: how many compaction rewrites one worker holds resident at once. No-op units never take one. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.maxConcurrentUnits | int | `40` | Throughput bound: units one worker executes at once across both lanes; the lanes' maxAckPending split this number. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.recycleAfterPasses | int | `150` | Retire a worker after this many committed rewrites to shed retained memory; 0 disables. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.recycleAtMemoryFraction | float | `0.7` | Retire a worker when resident memory reaches this fraction of its cgroup limit (0.70 = ~2.87 GiB of 4Gi); 0 disables. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.replicas | int | `2` | Number of worker pods; they are competing consumers of the work and index queues. More than 1 also renders a PDB. |
| maintenance.dedicatedWorkers.resources | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":2,"memory":"4Gi"},"requests":{"cpu":"250m","memory":"1Gi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits of each worker pod, sized for the compaction work rather than the planner's 512Mi. |
| maintenance.discoveryMaxDepth | int | `3` | How deep the bucket walk descends looking for a dataset's `_versions/`; a subtree it stops inside is an IncompleteScan that blocks the purge. |
| maintenance.distributedCompaction | bool | `false` | Let the catalog plan and commit compaction while this pod only rewrites, signed by a vended credential; falls back to in-pod compaction. Off by default. |
| maintenance.driftRepair | bool | `false` | Revoke OpenFGA tuples whose object no registry names (ghost projects/warehouses/tables); deletes tuples only. Off by default. |
| maintenance.driftRepairDryRun | bool | `true` | Plan and report drift repair without deleting any tuple. Defaults true. |
| maintenance.driftRepairMaxPerTick | int | `50` | Maximum objects drift repair revokes per reconcile tick; the remainder is reported as capped and taken next tick. |
| maintenance.enabled | bool | `true` | Deploy the maintenance service (planner, sweep and reconcile crons) and, with its other switches, the dedicated workers. |
| maintenance.expectedDatasets | int | `600` | Estate size the work lane is sized for; with `schedule` and `secondsPerUnit` it declares the required drain rate. |
| maintenance.floorRaise | bool | `false` | Write one metadata-only commit per stranded dataset to raise its Lance listing floor so residue becomes reclaimable. Off by default. |
| maintenance.floorRaiseDryRun | bool | `true` | Plan and report floor raises without committing. Defaults true; set false to commit once `floorRaise` is on. |
| maintenance.floorRaiseMaxPerTick | int | `10` | Maximum datasets the floor raise commits to per tick; the remainder is reported as capped. |
| maintenance.indexAckWait | string | `"3600s"` | Ack window for one index build unit (a duration, default 3600s); too short redelivers a build mid-flight to a second worker. |
| maintenance.indexDlqTopic | string | `"dlq.maintenance.index"` | Dead-letter topic for index build units that exhaust their retries. |
| maintenance.indexPubsub | string | `"maintenance-index-pubsub"` | Dapr pub/sub component name of the index build lane. |
| maintenance.indexTopic | string | `"maintenance.index.v1"` | Topic the catalog's create-index doors publish build units to for the workers. Empty builds the index inside the catalog request. |
| maintenance.lineageEmit | bool | `true` | Emit a lineage event per materially compacted dataset and a FAIL event per errored one; covers catalog-laid-out tables only. |
| maintenance.maxSourceBytes | int | `268435456` | Byte bound on what one compaction rewrite reads (default 256 MiB); fits together with the worker memory limit and concurrency. |
| maintenance.olderThanDays | int | `7` | Days of version history kept by old-version GC. |
| maintenance.orphanScan | bool | `true` | Run the reconciler's per-dataset unreferenced-file scan; read-only, and required for `trashPurge` to certify a clean report. |
| maintenance.policyRoot | string | `""` | S3 root of maintenance policy records. Empty falls back to `controlRoot`, then the primary bucket. |
| maintenance.port | int | `8000` | HTTP port of the maintenance planner and worker containers. |
| maintenance.reconcileBindingName | string | `"maintenance-reconcile-cron"` | Name of the Dapr cron binding that fires the drift reconciler (`MAINTENANCE_RECONCILE_BINDING_NAME`). |
| maintenance.reconcileSchedule | string | `"@every 300s"` | Cadence of the drift reconciler, which only reads OpenFGA, the control-root registries and the bucket listing. |
| maintenance.scanBatchSize | int | `64` | Rows per compaction read batch (Lance defaults to 8192); with large blob rows this bounds memory, set together with `compactThreads`. |
| maintenance.schedule | string | `"@every 120s"` | Sweep cron cadence. With `workTopic` set it is a backstop: relax to hourly but no slower than 75 minutes. |
| maintenance.secondsPerUnit | int | `14` | Measured end-to-end seconds per work unit (dispatch, ack and queueing included), used with `expectedDatasets` to size the lane. |
| maintenance.sweepBudgetSeconds | int | `0` | Wall-clock ceiling for one sweep tick, checked between datasets; 0 means unlimited. |
| maintenance.tombstoneSweep | bool | `false` | Clear trash records whose bytes a probe proves are gone; deletes bookkeeping rows, never bytes. Off by default. |
| maintenance.tombstoneSweepDryRun | bool | `true` | Plan and report the tombstone sweep without clearing anything. Defaults true. |
| maintenance.tombstoneSweepMaxPerTick | int | `50` | Maximum trash records the tombstone sweep probes and clears per tick; the remainder is reported as capped. |
| maintenance.trashPurge | bool | `false` | Delete the bytes of trash records past their grace deadline and revoke their grants, only when that tick's drift report is clean. Irreversible; off by default. |
| maintenance.trashPurgeDryRun | bool | `false` | Run the purge pass for real but perform no mutation, reporting `would_purge`; adds full read cost. |
| maintenance.trashPurgeMaxPerTick | int | `25` | Maximum trash records purged per tick; the remainder is reported as capped and drained next tick. |
| maintenance.tupleRebuild | bool | `false` | Recreate OpenFGA tuples the control-plane registries still justify (project admin seed, warehouse tenancy); additive only. Off by default. |
| maintenance.tupleRebuildDryRun | bool | `true` | Plan and report the tuple rebuild without writing. Defaults true. |
| maintenance.tupleRebuildMaxPerTick | int | `50` | Maximum tuples the rebuild writes per tick; the remainder is reported as capped. |
| maintenance.vendWriteCredentials | bool | `true` | Sign each compaction write with a per-table credential vended by the catalog instead of the deployment's S3 key; falls back per dataset. |
| maintenance.workDlqTopic | string | `"dlq.maintenance.work"` | Dead-letter topic for compaction work units that exhaust their retries. |
| maintenance.workPubsub | string | `"maintenance-work-pubsub"` | Dapr pub/sub component name of the compaction work lane. |
| maintenance.workTopic | string | `"maintenance.work.v1"` | Topic the sweep publishes one unit per dataset to. Empty runs the whole sweep inside the cron request (the serial lane). |
| medallion.buckets | object | `{}` | Map of stage namespace to S3 bucket (e.g. `{gold: lance-sink}`); unset namespaces use `minio.bucket`. Listed buckets are auto-created and reserved from warehouses. |
| medallion.cascadeLag.bindingName | string | `"medallion-cascade-lag-cron"` | Name of the read-only cascade-lag cron Component, the producer's MEDALLION_CASCADE_LAG_BINDING_NAME and its route. Empty disables the lag detector. |
| medallion.cascadeLag.schedule | string | `"@every 300s"` | Dapr cron schedule on which the producer measures per-edge cascade lag and sets the `medallion.cascade.lag` gauge. |
| medallion.compute | bool | `true` | Stages do a real Lance read, transform and write (MEDALLION_COMPUTE_ENABLED) rather than emitting lineage only; stage URIs derive from `minio.bucket` and each namespace. |
| medallion.enabled | bool | `true` | Deploy the medallion cascade: the medallion-producer head and the stage runners in `stageRunners`, with their pubsub components and crons. |
| medallion.fgaEnabled | bool | `false` | Each stage runner checks OpenFGA for its `requiredAction` on the target namespace before producing. Seed the stage-runner identity grants first. |
| medallion.goldWarehouse | bool | `false` | Route the terminal stage runner's project writes to the project's gold serving warehouse when one exists (MEDALLION_GOLD_WAREHOUSE_ENABLED). Off = work warehouse. |
| medallion.inprocessTasks | list | `[{"cardinalities":["1:1","1:N"],"command":"medallion.transform_stage","task":"stage-transform"}]` | Tasks the in-process plane can run, registered at boot (MEDALLION_INPROCESS_TASKS) whether or not Ray is on: `task`, `command`, optional `cardinalities`. |
| medallion.mediaBronzeNamespace | string | `"bronze-media"` | Bronze namespace of the media lane, where /ingest-media lands blobs (MEDALLION_MEDIA_BRONZE_URI). Default `bronze-media`. |
| medallion.mediaSeedSamples | bool | `true` | Have /ingest-media write two sample PNGs into the source prefix before ingesting (MEDALLION_MEDIA_SEED_SAMPLES); set false when the source is real media. |
| medallion.planSweep.bindingName | string | `"medallion-plan-sweep-cron"` | Name of the plan-sweep cron Component (MEDALLION_PLAN_SWEEP_BINDING_NAME and route) that resolves open Ray stage and training plans. Rendered only with `ray`; empty disables it. |
| medallion.planSweep.schedule | string | `"@every 30s"` | Dapr cron schedule of the plan sweep; four ticks is the grace a lost submission gets before it counts as never registered. |
| medallion.port | int | `8000` | HTTP port the medallion producer and stage runners listen on. |
| medallion.produceAdminProject | string | `"acme"` | Project a signed-in user needs `can_administer` on to fire /produce or /train from the UI, and the default project a projectless produce is checked against. |
| medallion.producer.author | string | `"ray"` | Author the producer stamps on its bronze-write lineage (MEDALLION_PRODUCER_AUTHOR). |
| medallion.producer.bronzeDataset | string | `"bronze$events"` | Dataset name the producer stamps on the bronze trigger (MEDALLION_BRONZE_DATASET); must equal the first stage runner's `fromDataset` or every trigger is dropped. |
| medallion.producer.bronzeNamespace | string | `"bronze"` | Bronze namespace the producer writes (MEDALLION_BRONZE_NAMESPACE), declared unqualified; on a projects estate it becomes `<project>-bronze` at runtime. |
| medallion.producer.bronzeTopic | string | `"medallion.bronze"` | Topic the producer's /bronze-arrival publishes the first cascade trigger on (MEDALLION_BRONZE_TOPIC); the first stage runner's `subTopic`. |
| medallion.producer.daprAppId | string | `"medallion-producer"` | Dapr app-id of the medallion-producer; also names its derived pubsub components, durable consumers and state-store scope. |
| medallion.producer.expose | bool | `true` | Intended to gate the gateway route to POST /produce (values-prod sets false). No chart template reads it. |
| medallion.producer.operation | string | `"lance_ray_ingest"` | Operation name the producer stamps on its bronze-write lineage (MEDALLION_PRODUCER_OPERATION). |
| medallion.producer.serviceIdentity | string | `"service-medallion-producer"` | Subject the producer presents at the catalog's service door and signs lineage as; the identity the FGA seed grants. Must not be blank. |
| medallion.producerReplicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the medallion-producer Deployment (default 1); replicas share a queue group, so each trigger is delivered once. |
| medallion.projectsEnabled | bool | `true` | Per-project routing: give producer and stage runners MEDALLION_CONTROL_ROOT so a `project` trigger resolves that project's warehouse. Off drops project triggers fail-closed. |
| medallion.promotionReviewBand | float | `0.25` | Fractional row-count change from the previous version that triggers a review (0.25 = 25%); a first promotion always asks. 0 asks about every change. |
| medallion.promotionTopic | string | `"medallion.promotion"` | Topic a stage runner holding a promotion publishes it on for the producer's review workflow (MEDALLION_PROMOTION_TOPIC). |
| medallion.quality | bool | `false` | Run data-quality assertions (row count, key column non-null, declared columns) after each stage write and block promotion on failure. Requires `compute`. |
| medallion.qualityKeyColumn | string | `"id"` | Column the quality gate asserts is non-null (MEDALLION_QUALITY_KEY_COLUMN). Used when `quality` is on. |
| medallion.qualityReview | bool | `false` | Route unusual (not broken) promotions to a person through the producer's promotion_review workflow instead of blocking; also scopes the producer on the state store. |
| medallion.qualityReviewApprover | string | `""` | OIDC subject asked to approve a held promotion. Empty = nobody can be asked and the review answers BLOCKED. |
| medallion.qualityReviewHours | int | `72` | Hours a promotion review stays open before the promotion is EXPIRED and not promoted. |
| medallion.ray | bool | `true` | Stage runners submit their transform as a Ray job (MEDALLION_RAY_ENABLED) to the estate's one Ray dashboard; the render fails if no Ray address is configured. |
| medallion.rayTasks | list | `[{"cardinalities":["1:1","1:N"],"command":"python /home/ray/jobs/ray_stage_job.py","task":"stage-transform"},{"cardinalities":["1:1"],"command":"python /home/ray/jobs/ray_dummy_job.py","task":"dummy-lane"},{"command":"python /home/ray/jobs/ray_train_job.py","task":"train"}]` | Tasks the Ray plane can run, registered by the producer at boot (MEDALLION_RAY_TASKS): `task`, baked `command`, optional `cardinalities` (empty = all). Rendered with `ray`. |
| medallion.stageRunnerReplicas | int | `1` | Replica count of each stage-runner Deployment (default 1); replicas form a competing-consumer queue group. |
| medallion.stageRunners | list | `[{"author":"data_eng","daprAppId":"bronze-to-silver","fromDataset":"bronze$events","fromNamespace":"bronze","name":"bronze-to-silver","operation":"embed_features","pubTopic":"medallion.silver","requiredAction":"can_create_table","requiredColumns":"id","serviceIdentity":"service-bronze-to-silver","subTopic":"medallion.bronze","toDataset":"silver$features","toNamespace":"silver"},{"author":"analyst","daprAppId":"silver-to-gold","fromDataset":"silver$features","fromNamespace":"silver","name":"silver-to-gold","operation":"aggregate_gold","pubTopic":"","requiredAction":"can_promote","requiredColumns":"id","serviceIdentity":"service-silver-to-gold","subTopic":"medallion.silver","toDataset":"gold$catalog","toNamespace":"gold"},{"author":"data_eng","daprAppId":"media-to-silver","fromDataset":"bronze-media$objects","fromNamespace":"bronze-media","name":"media-to-silver","operation":"derive_media","pubTopic":"","requiredAction":"can_create_table","requiredColumns":"id,thumbnail,embedding","serviceIdentity":"service-media-to-silver","subTopic":"medallion.media","toDataset":"silver-media$features","toNamespace":"silver-media"}]` | The stage runners, one Deployment each in DAG order: name, daprAppId, from/to namespace and dataset, operation, author, sub/pub topics, requiredAction, serviceIdentity, requiredColumns. |
| medallion.train.entrypoint | string | `"python /home/ray/jobs/ray_train_job.py"` | Ray job entrypoint the trainer submits (MEDALLION_TRAIN_ENTRYPOINT); the script must be baked into the Ray cluster image. |
| medallion.train.lineageUrl | string | `""` | Lineage URL the training job emits its RunEvents to (MEDALLION_TRAIN_LINEAGE_URL). Empty = the release's own lineage Service. |
| medallion.train.modelsNamespace | string | `"models"` | Catalog namespace the model registry writes trained models into (MEDALLION_MODELS_NAMESPACE). |
| medallion.train.topic | string | `"training.jobs"` | Topic the /train head publishes training requests on and the trainer consumer subscribes to (MEDALLION_TRAIN_TOPIC). |
| medallion.train.trainerIdentity | string | `"service-trainer"` | Service identity training runs act and emit as (MEDALLION_TRAINER_IDENTITY). |
| minio.accessKey | string | `"minioadmin"` | Access key id of the store's root account; its secret is the store's `minio-secret-key`. No service should present it. |
| minio.bucket | string | `"lance-catalog"` | The lakehouse root bucket (catalog `LANCE_REST_ROOT`, warehouse registry, lineage outbox). |
| minio.buckets | list | `[]` | Extra platform buckets the bucket-init Job creates and the reconcile exempts from orphan_buckets; governed tiers only, not the root or feature buckets. |
| minio.catalogAccessKey | string | `"rask-catalog"` | Access key of the catalog's scoped store identity; the secret derives in-cluster (`lance.scopedSecretFn`). Wide on data, no admin rights. |
| minio.enabled | bool | `true` | This estate uses the development object store (deploy/fixtures/minio, Service `<release>-minio`): rask runs its bucket-init Job and scoped-users hook against it and its dev store issues the root credential. Off with `externalEndpoint` set uses a managed S3. The chart renders no MinIO server. |
| minio.externalEndpoint | string | `""` | S3 endpoint the apps use instead of the in-cluster MinIO; pair with `minio.enabled=false`. Empty uses the in-cluster store. |
| minio.lineageAccessKey | string | `"rask-lineage"` | Access key of the lineage service's scoped store identity (read-only plus deletes of its own outbox); secret derives in-cluster. |
| minio.maintenanceAccessKey | string | `"rask-maintenance"` | Access key of maintenance's scoped store identity, the fallback when vending degrades; secret derives in-cluster. |
| minio.medallionAccessKey | string | `"rask-medallion"` | Access key the medallion producer and stage runners share; secret derives in-cluster. Data in any warehouse, `_tasks/` writable. |
| minio.oidc.enabled | bool | `false` | The development store trusts Dex id_tokens for STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity (`vending.mode: web_identity`): ESO writes the Dex client secret it reads into `<release>-infra-credentials`. Turn on the fixture's `oidc.enabled` with it. |
| minio.port | int | `9000` | S3 API port of the development store's Service. |
| minio.rayComputeAccessKey | string | `"rask-ray-compute"` | Access key of the Ray compute plane's scoped store identity, kept off the tenant root; secret derives in-cluster. |
| minio.viewerAccessKey | string | `"rask-viewer"` | Access key of the object browser's scoped identity (list and get only); secret derives in-cluster. |
| nameOverride | string | `""` | Overrides the chart name used in `rask.name` labels when `fullnameOverride` is empty. Empty uses the chart name. |

| The bus user table, one user per Dapr app-id plus admin, monitor and ingest, each with publish and subscribe subject lists (never empty). |
| nats.monitorUrl | string | `""` | HTTP monitoring endpoint of the bus (varz/jsz) the lakehouse zone's ops view reads (e.g. http://rask-nats-headless:8222). Empty hides the panel. |
| nats.streamReplicas | int | `3` | Raft replica count for every stream the stream Job provisions; must not exceed the bus's node count. |
| nats.url | string | `""` | NATS JetStream address every pub/sub component, the stream Job and ingest connect to (e.g. nats://nats.internal:4222). Required: empty fails the render. |
| networkPolicy.enabled | bool | `false` | Renders default-deny NetworkPolicies with explicit allows and exclusive client lists for the guarded stores. Needs a policy-enforcing CNI. |
| networkPolicy.extraEgress | list | `[]` | List of extra egress rules, verbatim NetworkPolicy entries, for external backends (off-cluster S3, managed NATS, external OTLP). |
| networkPolicy.minioExtraFrom | list | `[{"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app":"ray-lance-head"}}},{"podSelector":{"matchLabels":{"app":"ray-lance-worker"}}}]` | List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach the object store; defaults admit the ray-lance demo pods. |
| networkPolicy.openbaoExtraFrom | list | `[]` | List of extra NetworkPolicy `from` peers allowed to reach OpenBao (e.g. the external-secrets namespace). |
| observability.enabled | bool | `false` | Deploy rask's OTel Collector and turn on OTLP export from the fleet, Dapr and OpenFGA to it; needs `export.endpoint`. |
| observability.environment | string | `"rask"` | Value of the `deployment.environment.name` OTel resource attribute; empty falls back to the release namespace. |
| observability.export.auditHeaders | object | `{"x-greptime-log-table-name":"lance_audit"}` | Headers added to the export of `lance.audit` records, which leave on their own exporter. |
| observability.export.endpoint | string | `""` | OTLP/HTTP base URL the Collector exports traces, metrics and logs to (`/v1/traces` etc. are appended); the platform's backend. Required while `enabled`: empty fails the render. |
| observability.export.headers | object | `{"x-greptime-db-name":"public"}` | Headers sent on every export. |
| observability.export.traceHeaders | object | `{"x-greptime-pipeline-name":"greptime_trace_v1"}` | Headers added to the trace export. |
| observability.otelCollector.image | string | `"otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib:0.157.0"` | Container image for the OTel Collector (contrib distribution). |
| observability.query.auditTable | string | `"lance_audit"` | Table the audit viewer reads `lance.audit` records from; the same table `export.auditHeaders` routes them to. |
| observability.query.url | string | `""` | Base URL of the store's SQL and PromQL API the zones read (GREPTIME_API); empty leaves those panels without data. |
| observability.samplingRate | string | `"1"` | Dapr tracing sampling rate in the Dapr Configuration, as a string from 0 to 1; "1" traces every request. |
| openbao.devMode | bool | `true` | The development store: in-memory, auto-unsealed with a fixed root token (demo only), run by the openbao fixture. False renders a sealed file-backed server an operator must init and unseal. |
| openbao.devToken | string | `"root"` | Root token of the development store (the openbao fixture's `devToken`), which the Dapr secret store presents when `devMode` is true. |
| openbao.enabled | bool | `true` | An in-cluster OpenBao at `<release>-openbao`: with `devMode` the development store (deploy/fixtures/openbao), whose seed runs the scripts this chart renders (`<release>-openbao-seed`); without it the sealed server this chart renders. |
| openbao.externalAddr | string | `""` | Address of an external Vault/OpenBao the secret stores point at instead of the in-cluster server; pair with `openbao.enabled=false`. |
| openbao.image | string | `"openbao/openbao:2.2.0"` | OpenBao container image; also used by the MinIO scoped-users hook. |
| openbao.port | int | `8200` | Port of the OpenBao Service. |
| openbao.storage | string | `"1Gi"` | PVC size of the file backend when `devMode` is false. |
| openfga.authn.method | string | `"oidc"` | Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA API authentication method; `oidc` admits only projected ServiceAccount tokens. |
| openfga.authn.oidc.audience | string | `"rask-openfga"` | Token audience OpenFGA requires; templates/openfga-authn.yaml refuses a render unless it equals `lance.openfgaAudience` (rask-openfga). |
| openfga.authn.oidc.issuer | string | `"http://{{ .Release.Name }}-issuer-mirror:8080"` | Subchart passthrough (tpl-rendered): the OIDC issuer OpenFGA fetches keys from, the release's ServiceAccount issuer mirror. |
| openfga.datastore | object | `{"applyMigrations":false,"engine":"postgres","existingSecret":"rask-infra-credentials","maxIdleConns":10,"maxOpenConns":30,"secretKeys":{"uriKey":"openfga-datastore-uri"},"waitForMigrations":false}` | Subchart passthrough: Postgres datastore on the AGE server, DSN from `rask-infra-credentials`, bundled migrations off (rask's Job migrates), pool 30 open/10 idle. |
| openfga.enabled | bool | `true` | Install the OpenFGA authorization server subchart, plus rask's migrate Job, authn subject ConfigMap and PodDisruptionBudget for it. |
| openfga.extraEnvVars | list | `[{"name":"OPENFGA_EXPERIMENTALS","value":"weighted_graph_check"},{"name":"OPENFGA_AUTHN_OIDC_ISSUER_ALIASES","value":"https://kubernetes.default.svc.cluster.local"},{"name":"OPENFGA_AUTHN_OIDC_SUBJECTS","valueFrom":{"configMapKeyRef":{"key":"subjects","name":"rask-openfga-authn"}}}]` | Subchart passthrough env: OPENFGA_EXPERIMENTALS=weighted_graph_check, the OIDC issuer alias, and the subject allow-list from `rask-openfga-authn`. |
| openfga.http | object | `{"corsAllowedHeaders":["Authorization"],"corsAllowedOrigins":["https://openfga.invalid"]}` | Subchart passthrough: CORS for the OpenFGA HTTP API, closed by allowing only the unreachable origin `https://openfga.invalid`. |
| openfga.image.tag | string | `"v1.18.3"` | OpenFGA image tag for the subchart server and for rask's own migrate Job (templates/openfga-migrate.yaml), so schema and binary match. |
| openfga.playground.enabled | bool | `false` | Subchart passthrough: the OpenFGA browser playground; off, since it only runs with authn `none`. |
| openfga.replicaCount | int | `1` | Subchart passthrough: number of OpenFGA server replicas. |
| openfga.resources | object | `{"limits":{"memory":"2Gi"},"requests":{"cpu":"50m","memory":"512Mi"}}` | Subchart passthrough: CPU and memory requests/limits for the OpenFGA server. |
| openfga.telemetry | object | `{"trace":{"enabled":false,"otlp":{"endpoint":"rask-otel-collector:4317"},"sampleRatio":0.001}}` | Subchart passthrough: OpenFGA OTLP tracing to the OTel Collector; off by default, ratio 0.001 because each Check emits ~1,900 spans. |
| podDisruptionBudget.enabled | bool | `false` | Renders a PodDisruptionBudget for each service, controlplane and zone running more than one replica. |
| podDisruptionBudget.minAvailable | int | `1` | minAvailable of every rendered PodDisruptionBudget. |
| pubsub.controlName | string | `"catalog-control-pubsub"` | Name of the broadcast (no queue group) Dapr pubsub component for catalog.control.v1; must match the catalog's LANCE_CONTROL_PUBSUB default. Used when `controlEmit` is on. |
| pubsub.name | string | `"lineage-pubsub"` | Name of the shared lineage publish Dapr pubsub component; each subscriber app gets a derived `<name>-<app-id>` component with its own queue group. |
| pubsub.topic | string | `"lineage.events.v1"` | Topic OpenLineage run events are published and subscribed on (LANCE_DAPR_TOPIC, MEDALLION_LINEAGE_TOPIC and siblings). |
| ray.auth.enabled | bool | `false` | rask's Ray clients present the token in `<release>-ray-auth-token`; the engine must enforce the same one. Off for dev. |
| ray.dashboardUrl | string | `""` | Address of the engine's Ray dashboard, used verbatim by every Ray consumer; the ray-cluster fixture serves http://rask-ray-head-svc:8265. |
| ray.enabled | bool | `true` | rask talks to a Ray engine: the NetworkPolicy admits the pods KubeRay marks `ray.io/is-ray-node`, and the Collector scrapes them. |
| ray.engineServiceAccount | string | `""` | Service account (in the release namespace) whose tokens rask admits as the trainer; empty admits none. The ray-cluster fixture runs its head as `<rask>-sa-ray`. |
| resources.age | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"2Gi"},"requests":{"cpu":"250m","memory":"512Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the AGE Postgres StatefulSet (lineage and OpenFGA databases). |
| resources.assist | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"8","memory":"6Gi"},"requests":{"cpu":"1","memory":"2Gi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the assist model runner (two warm torch models). |
| resources.catalog | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"250m","memory":"128Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the catalog; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful. |
| resources.compute | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"1536Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"100m","memory":"512Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the compute service, sized for the Ray Job SDK it imports. |
| resources.default | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"50m","memory":"128Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for every lakehouse app container that names no tier of its own (lance.resources). |
| resources.fleet | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"50m","memory":"128Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for fleet services (templates/fleet.yaml) that name no tier of their own. |
| resources.lineage | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"250m","memory":"128Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for lineage; requests sized so the HPA CPU target is meaningful. |
| resources.otel-collector | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"1","memory":"512Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"300m","memory":"512Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the OTel Collector; memory limit matches its hardcoded 400 MiB memory_limiter. |
| resources.viewer | object | `{"limits":{"cpu":"2","memory":"1536Mi"},"requests":{"cpu":"200m","memory":"768Mi"}}` | CPU/memory requests and limits for the explorer viewer (in-process KG engine and atlas cache). |
| runners.assist.image | object | `{"repository":"assist-runner","tag":"dev"}` | Assist runner image: `repository` and `tag`; the tag is required when runners are enabled. |
| runners.assist.port | int | `8110` | HTTP port of the assist runner Service. |
| runners.enabled | bool | `false` | Deploy the `assist` model runner and point the annotator's MEDIA_ASSIST_URL at it instead of its in-repo mock. |
| runners.jobsUrl | string | `""` | RayJob submit endpoint for the annotator's batch-labeling seam (MEDIA_JOBS_URL). Empty = the annotator keeps its submit/poll mock. |
| secrets.hfTokenInStore | bool | `false` | True once the Hugging Face token is in the secret store at `<kvMount>/hf-token`; renders the `<release>-hf-token` ExternalSecret. False starts Ray pods without HF_TOKEN. |
| security.infraContexts.age | object | `{"fsGroup":999,"runAsUser":999}` | uid/fsGroup for the AGE Postgres pod (postgres image uid/gid 999). |
| security.infraContexts.enabled | bool | `false` | Applies pinned runAsUser/fsGroup securityContexts to the infra pods (AGE, OpenBao). Off by default. |
| security.infraContexts.openbao | object | `{"fsGroup":1000,"runAsUser":100}` | uid/fsGroup for the OpenBao pod (image uid 100). |
| security.readOnlyRootFilesystem | bool | `true` | Read-only root filesystem for every first-party app container; each gets a writable /tmp emptyDir. |
| security.tmpSizeLimit | string | `"2Gi"` | sizeLimit of each app's /tmp emptyDir (upload spool, Lance spill, OTel queue); stops one pod filling the node's disk. |
| services.catalog.daprAppId | string | `"catalog"` | Dapr app-id of the catalog; also names its pubsub components and durable consumers. |
| services.catalog.module | string | `"catalog.main:app"` | uvicorn import path the catalog Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml). |
| services.catalog.port | int | `2333` | Container and Service port of the Lance catalog. |
| services.catalog.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the catalog; above 1 requires catalog.controlEmit=true or the render fails. |
| services.compute.daprIngest | bool | `true` | Renders APP_API_TOKEN for compute, whose boot refuses to start with Dapr on and no token (it hosts the prune cron route). |
| services.compute.frontDoor | bool | `true` | Renders compute outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/ray and /api/serve to it. |
| services.compute.governedAuth | bool | `true` | Gives compute the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled; without it its routes answer anonymously. |
| services.compute.module | string | `"compute:app"` | uvicorn import path the compute Deployment runs. |
| services.compute.port | int | `8804` | Container and Service port of the compute app (Ray introspection and the /api/serve proxy). |
| services.compute.rayClient | bool | `true` | Gives compute the RAY_AUTH_* env when ray.auth.enabled, for dashboard introspection and the Serve proxy. |
| services.compute.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the compute Deployment; 0 scales it to zero. |
| services.compute.waitFor | list | `[]` | List of dependencies compute waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled). |
| services.flows.frontDoor | bool | `true` | Renders flows outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/flows to it. |
| services.flows.governedAuth | bool | `true` | Gives flows the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled; its run door checks the writer tier. |
| services.flows.module | string | `"flows:app"` | uvicorn import path the flows (studio flow-builder server) Deployment runs. |
| services.flows.port | int | `8840` | Container and Service port of the flows app. |
| services.flows.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the flows Deployment; 0 scales it to zero. |
| services.flows.waitFor | list | `[]` | List of dependencies flows waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled). |
| services.gateway.frontDoor | bool | `true` | Renders the gateway outside singleTenant; it is the /api entry point. |
| services.gateway.healthPath | string | `"/livez"` | Liveness probe path of the gateway (default `/livez`). |
| services.gateway.module | string | `"gateway:app"` | uvicorn import path the gateway Deployment runs. |
| services.gateway.port | int | `8888` | Container and Service port of the gateway (the /api reverse proxy the Ingress routes to). |
| services.gateway.readyPath | string | `"/readyz"` | Readiness probe path of the gateway (default `/readyz`); it asks no upstream, so the gateway stays Ready without backends. |
| services.gateway.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the gateway Deployment; 0 scales it to zero. |
| services.gateway.waitFor | list | `[]` | List of dependencies the gateway waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled). |
| services.ingest.cronBindingName | string | `""` | Name of the Dapr cron binding for the incremental poll (templates/ingest-cron.yaml). Empty renders no binding and the poll is off. |
| services.ingest.cronDataset | string | `""` | Dataset the incremental poll lands into. No template renders it; the app reads RASK_INGEST_CRON_DATASET, which this value does not reach. |
| services.ingest.cronKind | string | `""` | Source kind the incremental poll ingests. No template renders it; the app reads RASK_INGEST_CRON_KIND, which this value does not reach. |
| services.ingest.cronOptions | string | `""` | Source options for the incremental poll. No template renders it; the app reads RASK_INGEST_CRON_OPTIONS, which this value does not reach. |
| services.ingest.cronSchedule | string | `"@every 1h"` | Schedule of the incremental-poll cron binding (Dapr cron syntax, e.g. `@every 1h`). Used only when cronBindingName is set. |
| services.ingest.daprIngest | bool | `false` | Renders APP_API_TOKEN for an app that refuses to start without it. False for ingest, which gets the token through lanceWriter instead. |
| services.ingest.env | object | `{"RASK_CATALOG_SERVICE_IDENTITY":"service-ingest","RASK_CATALOG_URL":"http://rask-catalog:2333","RASK_INGEST_LANCE_ROOT":"","RASK_INGEST_LOCAL_ROOT":"","RASK_INGEST_MAX_RUN_HOURS":"24","RASK_INGEST_MAX_UNITS":"250000","RASK_INGEST_SECRETS_FROM_DAPR":"true","RASK_INGEST_SERVICE_PROJECT":"demo","RASK_INGEST_USE_CATALOG":"true","RASK_LINEAGE_ENDPOINT":"http://rask-lineage:8000","RASK_LINEAGE_SERVICE_IDENTITY":"service-ingest","RASK_LINEAGE_URL":"http://rask-lineage:8000"}` | Env-var map rendered verbatim into the ingest container: lineage/catalog URLs and identities, the pinned service project, local-dir and lance-append roots (empty refuses the kind), unit and run-hour ceilings. |
| services.ingest.frontDoor | bool | `true` | Renders ingest outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/ingest to it. |
| services.ingest.governedAuth | bool | `true` | Gives ingest the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled, feeding its user door. |
| services.ingest.incrementalMaxRows | int | `0` | Ceiling on rows the poll's anti-join reads; 0 is unbounded, over it the run refuses. No template renders it; the app reads RASK_INGEST_INCREMENTAL_MAX_ROWS. |
| services.ingest.lanceWriter | bool | `true` | Injects the S3 endpoint, warehouse, lineage outbox and LANCE_REST_ROOT env so ingest can write Lance to the warehouse. |
| services.ingest.module | string | `"ingest:create_app"` | uvicorn import path (module:factory) the ingest Deployment runs. |
| services.ingest.port | int | `8830` | Container and Service port of the ingest app. |
| services.ingest.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the ingest Deployment; 0 scales it to zero. |
| services.ingest.waitFor | list | `[]` | List of dependencies the pod waits for in an init container before starting; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled). |
| services.lineage.ageStatementTimeoutSeconds | int | `30` | Server-side per-statement timeout in seconds on lineage's AGE pool; bounds a runaway Cypher traversal. |
| services.lineage.daprAppId | string | `"lineage"` | Dapr app-id of lineage; also names its pubsub, DLQ and durable consumers and scopes its reconcile cron. |
| services.lineage.demoData | bool | `false` | Mounts the unauthenticated /demo/* data-peek router. Demo only; off by default. |
| services.lineage.eventsRetentionDays | int | `7` | Days of arrival time the durable /events feed keeps, pruned on the reconcile tick; bounds how long a notifications outage it survives. 0 is unbounded. |
| services.lineage.freshnessBudgetHours | int | `48` | Hours after which a dataset with no new version is flagged `stale` by reconcile and the dataset GET. 0 turns the check off. |
| services.lineage.module | string | `"lineage.main:app"` | uvicorn import path the lineage Deployment runs (templates/services.yaml). |
| services.lineage.outbox.enabled | bool | `true` | Stages each lineage event to `s3://<minio.bucket>/_lineage_outbox` before publishing, drained by reconcile. Requires reconcile.enabled. |
| services.lineage.port | int | `8000` | Container and Service port of the lineage service. |
| services.lineage.readAudit | bool | `true` | Records every allowed FGA-gated data read (feeds GET /datasets/{name}/readers). Rendered only when auth.enabled. |
| services.lineage.reconcile.bindingName | string | `"lineage-reconcile-cron"` | Name of the reconcile cron binding; the sidecar POSTs to /<bindingName>. |
| services.lineage.reconcile.enabled | bool | `true` | Renders the storage-to-graph reconcile cron, which back-fills lost lineage events, drains the outbox and prunes. Needs dapr.enabled. |
| services.lineage.reconcile.schedule | string | `"@every 300s"` | Schedule of the reconcile sweep (Dapr cron syntax, e.g. `@every 300s` or a cron expression). |
| services.lineage.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of lineage; replicas form a competing-consumer group, so it scales freely. |
| services.lineage.runRetentionDays | int | `30` | Days after which reconcile prunes graph :Run nodes and the Dataset nodes that leaves orphaned. 0 keeps everything. |
| services.notifications.channels.email.enabled | bool | `false` | Renders the `notifications-email` Dapr SMTP binding and adds `email` to RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_CHANNELS. Off by default. |
| services.notifications.channels.email.from | string | `""` | Sender address the email channel sends from. |
| services.notifications.channels.email.host | string | `""` | SMTP server host for the email channel. |
| services.notifications.channels.email.port | int | `587` | SMTP server port for the email channel (default 587). |
| services.notifications.channels.email.secretName | string | `"notifications-smtp"` | Secret-store key holding the SMTP `user` and `password` fields. |
| services.notifications.channels.slack.enabled | bool | `false` | Renders the Slack Dapr binding and adds `slack` to RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_CHANNELS. Off by default. |
| services.notifications.channels.slack.secretName | string | `"notifications-slack"` | Secret-store key holding the Slack `webhookUrl` field. |
| services.notifications.daprIngest | bool | `true` | Renders APP_API_TOKEN for notifications, which refuses to start with Dapr on and no token. |
| services.notifications.env | object | `{"RASK_LINEAGE_SERVICE_IDENTITY":"notifications"}` | Env-var map rendered verbatim into the notifications container; RASK_LINEAGE_SERVICE_IDENTITY is the subject it maps to at lineage's door. |
| services.notifications.frontDoor | bool | `true` | Renders notifications outside singleTenant, because the gateway routes /api/notifications to it. |
| services.notifications.governedAuth | bool | `true` | Gives notifications the OIDC/FGA env and FGA token mount when auth.enabled. |
| services.notifications.module | string | `"notifications:app"` | uvicorn import path the notifications (inbox) Deployment runs. |
| services.notifications.port | int | `8850` | Container and Service port of the notifications app. |
| services.notifications.reconcileBindingName | string | `"notifications-reconcile-cron"` | Name of the reconcile cron binding; also rendered as RASK_NOTIFICATIONS_BINDING_NAME so the tick reaches the matching route. |
| services.notifications.reconcileSchedule | string | `"@every 30s"` | Schedule of the reconcile cron over lineage's /events feed; must stay above the app's 25 s reconcile budget. |
| services.notifications.replicas | int | `1` | Replica count of the notifications Deployment; replicas form a competing-consumer group. 0 scales it to zero. |
| services.notifications.waitFor | list | `[]` | List of dependencies notifications waits for in an init container; only `minio` is honoured (when minio.enabled). |
| signing.doors | string | `"enforce"` | Mode of the bus doors' signature check: "off", "observe" (count would-refuse) or "enforce" (ack and refuse). Always quoted. |
| signing.enforce | bool | `true` | Lineage refuses unsigned or non-verifying events when the secret store and auth are also on. False renders no signer sets and lineage verifies nothing. |
| signing.mintImage | string | `"natsio/nats-box:0.19.7"` | Image of the dev OpenBao's `mint` init container that generates each identity's NKEY pair. |
| signing.provisioned | bool | `false` | Attest that signing keys exist for every identity in a non-dev store; the render fails until it is true there. |
| singleTenant.enabled | bool | `false` | Renders the single-tenant default workloads (every fleet service, domain zones). False installs front-door services only; the object store is gated by `minio.enabled`. |
| stateStore.componentVersion | string | `"v1"` | Version of the Dapr Postgres state store component. |
| stateStore.enabled | bool | `true` | Render the Dapr Postgres state store component (actor and workflow state) on the AGE `stateDb`. |
| stateStore.metadataTableName | string | `"dapr_metadata"` | Table the Dapr state store keeps its own metadata in. |
| stateStore.name | string | `"lance-statestore"` | Name of the Dapr state store component. |
| stateStore.scopes | list | `["annotator","catalog","ingest","flows","notifications"]` | App-ids allowed to load the state store; the secret-store scope is derived from this list too. Adding one needs a restart of scoped pods. |
| stateStore.secretStore | string | `"lance-secrets"` | Dapr secret store that resolves the state store's connection string (OpenBao, never a k8s Secret). |
| stateStore.tableName | string | `"state"` | Postgres table holding Dapr state rows. |
| storage.stores | list | `[{"bucket":"lance-catalog","description":"The lakehouse warehouse — the governed medallion datasets.","name":"lance-catalog","role":"bronze","secret":"viewer-s3"}]` | Object-store registry rendered as RASK_STORES for the fleet and the explorer viewer; each entry is {name, bucket, role, secret, description, endpoint?, insecure?}, `secret` a Dapr secret-store key. |
| vending.allowExternalBlobs | bool | `false` | Allow blob-v2 columns to reference arbitrary external objects (Blob.from_uri) on create. Off by default: an SSRF and dangling-pointer risk; prefer `externalBlobBases`. |
| vending.assumeRoleArn | string | `"arn:aws:iam::000000000000:role/lance-vend"` | Role ARN passed on AssumeRole in `sts`/`web_identity` mode (LANCE_S3_ASSUME_ROLE_ARN); stores with inherited policies ignore it but boto3 requires it. |
| vending.encryption | object | `{}` | Server-side encryption for direct writes, carried in vended storage options: `algorithm` (AES256, aws:kms, aws:kms:dsse) and `kmsKeyId` (kms only). Empty = bucket default. |
| vending.externalBlobBases | string | `""` | Comma-separated allowlist of base URIs external blob pointers may live under (LANCE_EXTERNAL_BLOB_BASES). Empty = `s3://<minio.bucket>/models/`; a value replaces that default. |
| vending.mode | string | `"sts"` | How the catalog vends storage credentials for direct object I/O: `mode_b` (none, server-mediated), `web_identity`, `sts` (default, scoped AssumeRole) or `static`. |
| vending.ttlSeconds | int | `900` | Lifetime in seconds of a vended STS / web-identity credential (LANCE_VENDING_TTL_SECONDS). |
